title: fix(turning): part-off states the piece kept and a back stock
body:
Stacked on #3472 (merge #3472 first). Before #3472 merges, this PR stays based on `main`; it carries the #3472 commits until then.

## What changed

The Part (part-off) operation gets one setting, `kerf: PartKerf` (`crates/motion/src/turning/parting_law.rs`). It has two values:

- `kept`: the piece that is the finished part.
  - `CutOff` (the default) is the #3452 rule. The whole kerf is on the chuck side.
  - `Chuck` keeps the piece in the chuck. The whole kerf is on the free-end side, and a stub comes off the free end.
- `back_stock` (mm, 0 or more, default 0): the whole kerf stands this far off the parting plane, into the scrap side. The part keeps that much on its end face for a later facing pass.

Where the setting is:

- Kernel: `part_in` reads the scrap side and the kerf flank from the setting.
- Gouge law: `part_kerf_refusal_for` judges the kerf against the part that `kept` names. It treats the back stock as part material. The old `part_kerf_refusal` calls it with the default.
- Flipped setup (`job.rs`): a setup that holds the part end for end refuses only the default now. The refusal names the setting: "Set 'The part is' to 'Chuck piece'". With `Chuck`, the part-off generates.
- Project file: the keys `kept` (`cut_off` / `chuck`) and `back_stock` (`project/part_kerf_dto.rs`). Each key is written only when it is not the default.
- Page: the Passes tab of the Part op has "The part is" (Cut-off piece / Chuck piece) and "Back stock". Apply rides `EditOperationParams`.
- MCP: `edit_operation` patches `kept` and `back_stock` through `EditOperationParams`. No new tool is necessary.
- Validation: a negative or non-finite back stock is refused at the command door (`is_sane`), in the kernel and in the verdict.
- Stamp: the setting is folded only when it is not the default. Thus no op saved before the setting reads stale.

The decision record: `docs/decisions/3469-part-kept-side.md`.

## Cause

#3472 put the whole kerf on the chuck side, and no parameter could change the side. In a flipped second setup the chuck holds the finished part. #3472 had to refuse every part-off there, which refuses a legal program (issue comments of 2026-11-22).

## Readings (3 mm GT-0300 blade, orientation 2: the -Z corner is posted)

| case | kerf | posted Z |
|---|---|---|
| #3452 pin, end face Z-70, default | Z-73..-70 | Z-73 (no change) |
| same, back stock 0.5 | Z-73.5..-70.5 | Z-73.5 |
| same, chuck piece | refused: "nothing to part ... stands wholly on the free-end side (higher Z) ... set 'The part is' to 'Cut-off piece'" | - |
| stubbed pin in the OP20 flip setup, plane Z-14, default | refused by name (names 'Chuck piece') | - |
| same, chuck piece | Z-14..-11 | Z-14 (the part's end face) |
| motion: part Z0..70 in the chuck, stub to Z84, plane Z70, chuck piece | Z70..73 | - |
| same, chuck piece, back stock 1 | Z71..74 | - |

## Tests

New pins. Each was red on the unchanged code (#3472 head 6c18258d1): the motion and app pins did not compile (no `PartKerf`, no `kerf` field), and the flip pin is refused there.

- `crates/motion/tests/turning_part_kept.rs` (new, 5 tests):
  - `the_default_setting_parts_the_3452_case_as_before`
  - `a_back_stock_moves_the_whole_kerf_into_the_bar`: the kerf, and the refusal of the default kerf "0.500 mm into the 0.500 mm back stock".
  - `the_chuck_piece_turns_the_kerf_to_the_free_end`: the kerf, no rule note, and the refusal of the default kerf on that model ("3.000 mm past", "free-end side (higher Z)").
  - `the_chuck_piece_with_no_model_below_the_plane_is_refused_by_name`
  - `a_back_stock_that_is_not_a_size_is_refused`: -0.1, NaN, infinity, in the kernel and in the verdict.
- `crates/app/tests/lathe_part_off_kerf.rs` (4 new tests):
  - `a_flipped_setup_keeping_the_chuck_piece_cuts_the_stub_off_the_free_end`: generates, posts Z-14.
  - `a_back_stock_posts_the_kerf_that_far_into_the_bar`: posts Z-73.5.
  - `the_chuck_piece_with_nothing_in_the_chuck_is_refused_by_name`
  - `the_kerf_setting_is_an_undoable_edit_and_rides_the_project_file`: no key at the default, a negative back stock refused by `EditOperationParams::new`, edit, undo, redo, save and open.
- `crates/app/tests/mcp_part_kerf.rs` (new): `edit_operation_sets_the_kept_piece_and_back_stock_and_undo_restores_them`.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/part_kerf_tests.rs` (new): `the_kept_piece_row_names_both_pieces_and_its_pick_applies_and_undoes`.

Changed pin (expected): `a_flipped_setup_refuses_the_part_off_by_name` now asks for the new refusal text ("cannot keep the cut-off piece", "'Chuck piece'").

Mechanical: each `OpParams::Part` and `PartParams` literal in the tests gets `kerf: Default::default()`.

### Mutation checks (each guard put back to the old code, then restored)

| mutation | result |
|---|---|
| kernel uses `chuck_side()` and the plane (ignores the setting) | RED: 3 tests of `turning_part_kept` |
| verdict ignores the back stock zone | RED: `a_back_stock_moves_the_whole_kerf_into_the_bar` |
| verdict uses `chuck_side()` (ignores `kept`) | RED: 2 chuck-piece tests |
| flip refusal unconditional again (the #3472 code) | RED: `a_flipped_setup_keeping_the_chuck_piece_cuts_the_stub_off_the_free_end` |
| no back stock check at the command door | RED: `the_kerf_setting_is_an_undoable_edit_and_rides_the_project_file` |

After the restore, all pins are green.

### Gate

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run` plans 730 steps (the motion change reaches every app binary). Thus each touched binary ran alone, debug, on head c6230e2a0:

- motion: `--lib` 536 passed (10 ignored); `turning_part_kept` 5; `turning_part_kerf` 6; `turning_blade` 11; `turning_stock` 5; `turning_contour_stock` 4.
- app: `lathe_part_off_kerf` 8; `mcp_part_kerf` 1; `lathe_blade_corner` 4; `catalog_groove_part_off` 1; `lathe_post` 7; `lathe_post_inch` 6; `turning_blade` 14; `setup_align_lathe` 4; `turning_stock_approach` 3; `drill_prior` 12; `coarse_laws` 6; `project_roundtrip` 76; `mcp_enum_patch` 3; `--lib part` 17.
- app `example_catalog -- groove cone`: 5 passed, 1 failed. The failure is `turning_cone_thread_case_posts_the_taper_and_the_thread` (`example_catalog.rs:311`, "the part-off reaches the axis"). It is in #3472, not in this PR. #3472 changed `cone-thread.nc` to `G01 X0. Z12.`, but the test still asks for `Z13.5`. This PR does not touch either file, and the two `regenerates` tests pass (the default posts the same bytes).
- ui: `--lib` 1432 passed (7 ignored).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

## Heavy lanes

GREEN on `c6230e2a0c5c6f9a7631c5a3386cc06e326310e1`: **244 steps, 0 failed**, 86.2 minutes. The gate ran all motion and app heavy targets, including the release build. The tool accepted the known-fail entries for #1950 and #2849 as red as expected.

Command: `RUSTC_WRAPPER= CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1 cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`.

At the start, `upstream/main` was `ebc5cadd46bd171465b93acb3e52e6d4488c498a`. During the run, the local ref advanced to `69997a6ded2d6ca559601c9233629045caabecda`. Explicit-base dry runs select the same 244 steps and exact Cargo commands for both SHAs.

### Full catalog comparison

Command: `cargo xtask gate batch --only 'app suites: example_catalog'`, with the compiler cache disabled. The PR ran with the gate job budget. The separate upstream worktree ran with `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=2`.

- Published PR head: **RED**, 36 passed, 1 failed, 4 ignored. `turning_cone_thread_case_posts_the_taper_and_the_thread` fails at `example_catalog.rs:311`: `the part-off reaches the axis`.
- Clean upstream `ebc5cadd46bd171465b93acb3e52e6d4488c498a`: **GREEN**, 37 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored. The same cone-thread test passes.
- The ignored heavy catalog tests passed in the heavy gate. They do not replace the full catalog suite.

This round changes no code, goldens, or PR head. It does not resolve the latest review's code or conflict findings. The PR remains a draft with `needs-rework`. No `merge-ready` label was added.

## Goldens moved

None. The default setting posts the same program. No `.nc`, `.cl` or catalog file changed.

## Not exercised

- A real control or machine. Lathe posts other than `fanuc-lathe.cps`.
- The UI in a live window (the page is tested through the kittest harness).

## Overlaps

- #3472: the stack base. It changes `parting_law.rs`, `parting.rs` and the flip refusal in `job.rs`, which this PR changes again.
- These open PRs touch the same files, but other functions or other kinds. None changes the Part variant, the Part page arm or the part-off law. Whichever merges second refreshes:
  - `operation/types/params.rs`, `project/params.rs`, `project/params_impl.rs`, `operation/kinds.rs`: #3494, #3441, #3439, #3426, #3402, #3391, #3387, #3353, #3283, #3251, #3103, #3058, #2890, #2831.
  - `operation/types/sane.rs`: #3426, #3402, #3283, #3251, #3058, #2831.
  - `operation/job.rs`: #3458, #3283, #3251, #3115, #3059, #3058, and older ones.
  - `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mod.rs` (one `mod` line): many open UI PRs.

Effort: high (not escalated).

Changelog: Part (part-off) has a new setting. "The part is" chooses the cut-off piece (the default, as before) or the chuck piece, which cuts a stub off the free end of a part held end for end. "Back stock" moves the whole kerf that far off the parting plane, so the part keeps material on its end face for a later facing pass. The gouge check judges the kerf against the part that the setting keeps. A part-off in a setup that holds the part end for end is refused only when the setting keeps the cut-off piece, and the refusal names the setting. Existing projects post the same program.

Fixes #3469
